title: Federated learning with heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise: a variance-reduction based algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2606.22466v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is an emerging distributed machine learning paradigm that enables local devices to jointly train a global model while keeping data decentralized and private. We propose a variance-reduction based algorithm, VRA-FedSGD, for FL in the presence of heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise, where these noises are prevalent in large-scale machine learning over wireless networks and Internet of Things deployments. VRA-FedSGD employs a momentum variance reduction technique together with a nonlinear mapping to mitigate heavy-tailed gradient noise, and uses a variance-reduced aggregation mechanism to suppress heavy-tailed communication noise. In the mean sense, VRA-FedSGD achieves a convergence rate of {\small$\mathcal{O}\left(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)}\right)$} for nonconvex objective functions, where $p$ is the tail index of heavy-tailed noise. translated_title: 具有重尾梯度噪声和通信噪声的联邦学习：一种基于方差缩减的算法
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）是一种新兴的分布式机器学习范式，它使本地设备能够在保持数据去中心化和隐私性的同时共同训练一个全局模型。我们提出了一种基于方差缩减的算法VRA-FedSGD，用于在重尾梯度噪声和通信噪声存在情况下的联邦学习，这类噪声在无线网络和物联网部署的大规模机器学习中普遍存在。VRA-FedSGD采用动量方差缩减技术结合非线性映射来缓解重尾梯度噪声，并使用方差缩减聚合机制来抑制重尾通信噪声。在均方意义下，VRA-FedSGD对于非凸目标函数实现了 O(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)}) 的收敛速率，其中 p 是重尾噪声的尾指数。在几乎必然意义下，VRA-FedSGD实现了……
tldr: 提出了一种基于方差缩减的联邦学习算法VRA-FedSGD，通过动量方差缩减结合非线性映射以及方差缩减聚合机制，有效应对重尾梯度噪声和通信噪声，并在均方和几乎必然意义下实现了对非凸目标的收敛速率保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes VRA-FedSGD, a variance-reduction based federated learning algorithm that mitigates heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise through momentum variance reduction with nonlinear mapping and variance-reduced aggregation, achieving convergence rates in both mean and almost sure senses for nonconvex objectives.
